message.content: Let me try a simpler approach - write the driver to a file in the source directory and build in one go.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && printf \"#include <stdint.h>\\n#include <stdio.h>\\n#include <stdlib.h>\\nint LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);\\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\\n    if(argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, \\\"usage: %%s <input_file>\\\\n\\\", argv[0]); return 1; }\\n    FILE* f = fopen(argv[1], \\\"rb\\\");\\n    if(!f) { perror(\\\"fopen\\\"); return 1; }\\n    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);\\n    long sz = ftell(f);\\n    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);\\n    uint8_t* buf = malloc(sz);\\n    if(fread(buf, 1, sz, f) != (size_t)sz) { perror(\\\"fread\\\"); return 1; }\\n    fclose(f);\\n    LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(buf, sz);\\n    free(buf);\\n    return 0;\\n}\\n\" > /tmp/test_driver.c && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I src /tmp/test_driver.c test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c src/md4c.c src/md4c-html.c src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz-mdhtml 2>&1 && echo BUILD_OK'"}
